name: Dental Implants & Grafting
desc: State-of-the-art titanium dental implants that look, feel, and function like natural teeth. Includes bone grafting, sinus lift, and All-on-4 procedures for full arch restoration.

name: Smile Makeover
short_desc: Complete aesthetic transformation of your smile.
desc: A comprehensive smile redesign combining teeth whitening, veneers, contouring, and bonding. Personalised to your facial features for a naturally radiant result.

name: Crowns & Bridges
short_desc: Durable restorations for damaged or missing teeth.
desc: Metal-free ceramic crowns and bridges that restore full function and aesthetics. Custom-shade-matched for a seamless look. Completed in just 2 visits.

name: Single Sitting RCT
short_desc: Painless root canal treatment in one appointment.
desc: Modern rotary endodontics with apex locators for precise, painless root canal treatment — often completed in a single sitting with minimal discomfort.

name: Teeth Whitening
short_desc: Professional brightening up to 8 shades whiter.
desc: Advanced in-office laser whitening and take-home custom tray kits. Safe, effective, and long-lasting. Results visible in as little as 45 minutes.

name: Braces & Clear Aligners
short_desc: Straighten your teeth discreetly and comfortably.
desc: Traditional metal braces, ceramic braces, and invisible clear aligners (like Invisalign). Bite correction and orthodontic treatment for all ages.

name: Porcelain Veneers
short_desc: Ultra-thin shells for a flawless smile.
desc: E-max and feldspathic porcelain veneers crafted to conceal chips, stains, gaps, and discolouration. Minimally invasive with dramatic aesthetic results.

name: Scaling & Deep Cleaning
short_desc: Remove plaque and protect your gum health.
desc: Professional ultrasonic scaling and root planing to eliminate tartar, control gum disease, and maintain a healthy oral environment. Recommended every 6 months.

name: Wisdom Tooth Extraction
short_desc: Painless surgical and simple tooth extractions.
desc: Painless surgical extractions of impacted wisdom teeth under local or IV sedation. Post-operative care and follow-up included for smooth recovery.

name: Paediatric Dentistry
short_desc: Gentle dental care for your little ones.
desc: Child-friendly dental check-ups, fluoride treatment, pit-and-fissure sealants, and habit corrections. Creating positive dental experiences from a young age.

name: Gum Treatment
short_desc: Advanced periodontal care for healthier gums.
desc: Comprehensive treatment for gingivitis and periodontitis including laser gum therapy, gum contouring, and regenerative procedures.

name: Dentures & Partials
desc: Complete and partial removable dentures crafted for comfort and aesthetics. Implant-supported dentures also available for superior retention.
